item.text: [{"task_id":"8fbca751","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    foreground = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    fill = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    size = int(round(params['size'][0]))","    result = grid.copy()","    if size <= 0:","        return result","    points = np.argwhere(grid == foreground)","    if len(points) == 0:","        return result","    row_start = int(np.min(points[:, 0]))","    col_start = int(np.min(points[:, 1]))","    height, width = grid.shape","    for row in range(row_start, height, size):","        for col in range(col_start, width, size):","            block = grid[row:min(row + size, height), col:min(col + size, width)]","            if np.any(block == foreground):","                result[row:min(row + size, height), col:min(col + size, width)] = np.where(block == background, fill, block)","    return result"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"size":[1]},"params":{"colors":[0,8,2],"size":[4]},"rationale":"The azure marks occupy aligned 4×4 tiles, anchored at the minimum occupied row and column.
